question: Wasim travels 234 km at a speed of 78 km/hr, the next 441 km at a speed of 49 km/hr, and the next 488 km at a speed of 61 km/hr. What is his average speed (in km/hr) for the entire journey?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total time taken = (234 ÷ 78) + (441 ÷ 49) + (488 ÷ 61) = 3 + 9 + 8 = 20 hours.

Total distance covered = 234 + 441 + 488 = 1163 km.

Average speed = Total distance ÷ Total time = 1163 ÷ 20 = 58.15 km/hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 58.15 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distance 1 (D₁) = 234 km, Speed 1 (S₁) = 78 km/hr

Distance 2 (D₂) = 441 km, Speed 2 (S₂) = 49 km/hr

Distance 3 (D₃) = 488 km, Speed 3 (S₃) = 61 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

⇒ Time for 2nd part (T₂) = 441 ÷ 49 = 9 hours

⇒ Time for 3rd part (T₃) = 488 ÷ 61 = 8 hours

⇒ Total Time = T₁ + T₂ + T₃ = 3 + 9 + 8 = 20 hours

⇒ Total Distance = 234 + 441 + 488 = 1163 km

⇒ Average Speed = 1163 ÷ 20

⇒ Average Speed = 58.15 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 58.15 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

General Average Speed Formula

Average speed is defined as the total distance covered divided by the total time taken. It is not the arithmetic mean of individual speeds unless the time durations are identical.

Average Speed for Equal Distances

If an object covers two equal distances at speeds x and y, the average speed for the entire journey is given by 2xy ÷ (x + y).

Average Speed for Equal Time Intervals

If a journey is travelled in different equal time slots with speeds S₁, S₂, ..., Sₙ, then Average Speed = (S₁ + S₂ + ... + Sₙ) ÷ n.
